Ready Player One

ISBN: 9780307887436

  • Ernest Cline
  • 2011
  • 374 pages
  • 4.2
Finished
Started: 2026-08-08 Finished: 2026-08-23

Review

4.2

During a visit to a local hands-on video game museum with some friends we got talking about the movie Ready Player One, and a friend of mine suggested I should read the book. So I did - and what a fantastic recommendation.

The sheer number of pop culture references, the incredible attention to detail, and the love for gaming and geek culture woven into every page are simply amazing.

After finishing the book, I rewatched the movie, and I can confidently say: the book is SO much better! It captures the magic, nostalgia, and excitement in a way the movie just can't quite match.

A fantastic read for anyone who loves gaming, pop culture, and a good dose of nostalgia!
